How we choose the right stack

We don't pick tools because they're new. Every project gets technology chosen against four questions.

Will it last?

We prefer mature, well-supported tools such as .NET, React, Angular, Python and PostgreSQL with long support lifecycles.

Can your team run it?

If you have in-house developers, we build with tools they already know, so you are never locked in to us.

What will it cost to host?

We size cloud services on AWS or Azure to your real traffic and show you the expected monthly bill up front.

Is it secure by default?

Encrypted data, role-based access, regular dependency updates and code review are part of every build.

See these tools in action in our web, mobile, AI and cloud services.
